rules.calibration: next chronological year80pct absolute-original-net residual interval only; no bias/threshold/weights adjustment

rules.economics: same100000RUB wholelots/max25pct/stock LONGonly; fee.05pct+slip.05pct eachperside; stressx2, unchanged decisions
rules.fits: 18 fixed fits:3Ridge+9MLP+3RandomForest+3medianHGB; same3 chronological splits, no search/refits/seedselection
rules.neural: same16/8tanh/200iterations/3seeds as prior; train-only2.5/97.5pct clipping of NORMALISED target; medianmembers*s at inference
rules.normalisation: s=max(past20day_volatility_pct,.25); eight return columns/s with sqrt5/20 horizon factors; originalvol/position/logvolume/onehot retained
rules.peers: 5 leave-self-out sameUTCinstant X-only features on normalised past1day returns; use every eligible peer even if future outcome unknown; no backfill
rules.policies: plain predictednet>.10pct; trend_guard additionally raw20dayreturn>0 AND distanceMA20>0 AND peerpositivefraction>=.5
rules.pullback: raw20dayreturn>0 AND distanceMA20>0 AND normalised1dayreturn<=-1 AND logrelativevolume>=0
rules.reuse: alltestyears previously viewed; exploratory reuse and manyprior trials; no independent proof/multiple-search correction/promotion
rules.scope: 8MLpolicies+2fixedrules, all reported; rules receive no invented point forecasts/profitprobabilities
rules.screen: 2025AND2026 each>=20dates, baseline and all1/3/5omissions positive and complete at BOTH costs; separate all3years flag
rules.sequence: v2 registered after partial2024 forecasts were seen; incomplete v1 run retained; no2025/26 volatility outcomes seen at repair
rules.stress: omit best1/3/5positivePnL origin dates IN HINDSIGHT with all stocks together and complete account rerun; fixedquarterdiagnostics retained
rules.strong_day: normaliseddaybody>=1 AND closeposition>=.75 AND logrelativevolume>=0 AND raw20dayreturn>0 AND peerpositivefraction>=.5
rules.task: unchanged17:45 features -> exact18open->nextcalendar10open; same7stock cachedrealEXCHANGE prices
rules.technical_repair: v1 partial2024 run halted on bitwise reload comparison; forest still trained n_jobs2, prediction pinned n_jobs1; no threshold/fitparameter/search changes
rules.training: train target net_y/s; weights equal perknowntrain date; train-only weighted StandardScaler, transformedfeatures clipped+-8
rules.unknowns: retain all eligible unknowns; selectedmissingprice poisons whole account; no known-subset-profit summaries
